sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone's current status is conditional (QS-C-2025 replaces the approved QS-C-2023). BR-220 would be a new part for them, so they cannot receive it.

sources.quote:
4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and the only approved source is SUP-B. SUP-C has no entry for this part, plant and customer. Their approvals are for BR-180 and BR-310. DEV-127, the request for a temporary source, was rejected.

sources.quote:
7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source, a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change
of coating or surface treatment.
7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which belongs to Aurelia. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. A change of source needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP) before shipment, and 90 days' notice. No Aurelia approval covers this change. Rejected DEV-127 is not one, and the board plan only says Greco will tell Aurelia.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-220 is made from EN AW-6082-T6, and the PFMEA names fatigue cracks at the fastening holes as a severity 9 failure.

sources.quote: SC-BR220-YS,BR-220,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires EN AW-6082-T6, with yield of at least 250 MPa. SUP-C is qualified only for 6082-T5 (typical yield 230 MPa) and 6061-T6. 'The same alloy' as BR-310 is the T5 temper, which is below the special characteristic.

sources.quote:
4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-C's 3.1 certificates cover only 6082-T5 and 6061-T6. There is none for the drawing material MAT-6082-T6. Open question for the SQE (Elena Gallo).
